title: Full UI rebuild with Tailwind and GitHub full-system UAT expansion
businessRules: R7 is the presentation/IA recovery wave after R1-R6 functional prerequisites are runtime-closed; business authority remains in existing APIs and server context.
Admin renders exactly one primary sidebar, one contextual secondary navigation, and one content surface. Parallel workspace rails/decks/context strips remain forbidden.
Four operator surfaces remain Tailwind CSS v4, flat one-accent, Lucide-based, responsive, keyboard-focusable, and free of decorative gradients or horizontal page overflow.
Dashboard analytics use reusable canonical chart primitives with one accent language; ad-hoc per-widget chart colors and decorative chart gradients are forbidden.

High-value capabilities remain discoverable in explicit workspaces, including owner digest/providers, control plane, reports, assets, marketplace, tenant/branch/warehouse, security/API keys, and truthful Forecast & Otomasi.
Exact-source Browser UAT must prove all visible Admin workspaces/contextual destinations, canonical analytics, desktop/tablet/mobile geometry, and screenshot evidence before F46 can close.
R8 remains responsible for expanded safe mutation journeys, exact release evidence, and remaining runtime revalidation such as F06/F40. Human Stage-20 remains separate.
acceptanceCriteria: F45 canonical chart component strategy replaces ad-hoc analytics SVG/colors/gradient behavior.
F46 Admin information architecture exposes all 14 canonical top-level workspaces with one contextual navigation layer and no stacked navigation.
Browser UAT records canonical chart evidence plus 14-workspace/contextual navigation sweep on the exact source fingerprint.
Admin, POS, Storefront, and Employee Portal pass 1440x900, 1024x768, and 390x844 no-overflow geometry checks.
R7 GitHub probe is required by both PostgreSQL workflows and aggregate release evidence.
Existing functional operator routes from R1-R6 remain reachable; no API/business logic is reimplemented in the client.
Focused R7 tests, workflow/repository/recovery/full-repo/UI audits, lint/build gates, and full dependency-free regression pass before push.
Human Stage-20 remains PENDING until operator visual/usability acceptance.
testPlan: GitHub uat:browser:built + ci:r7:probe on exact source/build artifact
migrationPlan: No database schema change is planned. Tailwind/PostCSS and CI/UAT changes are source/build tooling only; existing expand-only database migration chain remains unchanged and must still be rehearsed.
rollbackPlan: Revert this work item commit set to the last source-bound automated-GitHub-PASS commit. No database rollback is required because schema is unchanged. If the new UAT gate itself is defective, fix the gate while preserving or strengthening its assertions; never bypass it to release.
monitoringPlan: GitHub job summary and uploaded source-bound evidence will report API coverage, browser viewport coverage, provider simulation results, exact artifact identity, worker/report probe, staging/load/index/DR and Stage-20 automated state. UI regressions are additionally checked by local candidate gate before push.
securityNotes: All runtime identity continues to come from authenticated server context. CI uses non-production PostgreSQL and synthetic provider endpoints. GitHub secrets/environment secrets are never echoed, browser/localStorage evidence is sanitized, provider mocks validate headers/payloads without storing real tokens, and Human Stage-20 remains separately approved.
